caveats: All 4120 required daily files (1991-12-27 to 2003-01-05 for the threshold/climatology pools and 2021-06-01 to 2021-08-31 target period) were present and read successfully. 3310 of the 3600 region grid cells are sea cells (finite SST on every target day); the remaining 290 land cells are excluded from MHW detection and reported as 0. Thresholds use the Hazen (Hyndman-Fan type 5) 90th percentile of each day-of-year pool; day 60 values were set to the mean of days 59 and 61 and both fields were smoothed with a 31-day centred wrap-around moving mean.
